item.title: [+1] Brent falls up to 3% to about $110–112 in Asia as Iran–Qatar talks continue; OPEC+ holds December output
item.description:
No new escalation over the weekend after Friday's $117.64 six-month high. OPEC+ kept targets unchanged. Easing after an October surge.

Aviation, shipping & logistics: mild tailwind (+1) — Fuel costs ease

Why it matters: A pullback trims India's import bill and inflation risk, but prices above $110 and post-election strike risk keep pressure high.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance +1, Inflation outlook +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: days

item.title: [−1] Qatari LNG tanker with six Indians aboard attacked near Hormuz; crew safe
item.description:
The Pakistan-bound carrier was hit despite reported Iranian approval; Iran also claims two more tankers hit mines. First attack on LNG shipping in this round. Escalating.

Aviation, shipping & logistics: mild headwind (−1) — Crew risk

Why it matters: Attacks on LNG carriers threaten India's recovering Qatari gas supply, raising costs for power, fertiliser and city gas.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] US says no decision on Iran strikes before the 3 November vote; Israel reportedly urges strikes right after
item.description:
The US president says there is no hurry or timetable for a deal; talks continue via Qatari mediators and Iran's two-day reopening plan. Strike risk rises after Tuesday.

Aviation, shipping & logistics: mild headwind (−1) — Strike risk

Why it matters: The days after the US vote are a key oil risk window for India: strikes would lift crude, hurt the rupee and equities; a deal would bring relief.

Market gauges: Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1, Fiscal & trade balance −1

Confidence: low · horizon: days
